title: Perfect complexes are relatively perfect, and derived tensoring preserves relative perfectivity
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y flat locally of finite presentation between spaces over S, the lemma proves two closure statements: every perfect object of D(O_X) is Y-perfect, and K tensor^L M is Y-perfect whenever K is perfect and M is Y-perfect — the module-structure axioms for the relative perfect cone. The retained proof is written: via the chapter's affine-locality dictionary (lemma affine-locally-rel-perfect) reduce to affine schemes and apply the schemes theorem Derived Categories of Schemes, lemma perfect-relatively-perfect, which carries both clauses (absolutely perfect implies relatively perfect over any base, and the tensor closure) for flat finitely presented structure maps. Retained author proof at lines 12393-12399.
